mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopion.tPrfDuty (CompCode, DutyName, DutyDesc, DutySeq, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate) VALUES (#{compCode}, #{dutyName}, #{dutyDesc}, #{dutySeq}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE shopion.tPrfDuty SET DutyName = #{dutyName}, DutyDesc = #{dutyDesc}, DutySeq = #{dutySeq}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE DutyId = #{dutyId}
